breaches.before: exit 124 (timeout - opened blame GUI, accepted input)
breaches.after: exit 1 - 'fatal: test-file.txt is not a valid rev'
breaches.evidence: Path-before-rev argument ordering accepted in old parser, rejected in new parser. The old heuristic checked file existence in worktree to determine if an argument was a path. New parser uses strict positional parsing.
Old parser accepted extra arguments (beyond expected count). New parser enforces arg count validation via nargs vs maxargs check.
--line=<num> position enforced strictly in new parser. Old parser had loose --line placement rules.

breaches.before: exit 124 (timeout - no path validation, opened blank/blames window)
breaches.after: exit 1 - '<path> is not a filename in rev <rev>'
breaches.evidence: Old parser did not validate path existence in target rev. New parser uses git ls-tree to verify path existence before opening GUI.

breaches.before: exit 124 (timeout - no rev validation for non-hex strings)
breaches.after: exit 1 - 'fatal: <rev> is not a valid rev'
breaches.evidence: Old parser only validated hex-looking revs with git rev-parse. New parser validates ALL user-supplied revs with git rev-parse --verify.

breaches.old_behavior: Blank browser window (exit 124 timeout) - no error message
breaches.new_behavior: Exit 1 with clear error message on stderr: '<path> is not a directory in rev master'
breaches.before: exit 124 (timeout - blank browser window, no error feedback)
breaches.after: exit 1 - '<path> is not a directory in rev <rev>'
breaches.evidence: Error handling changed from silent failure (blank window) to explicit error message via show_parse_err. Observable by users and any automation.

methodology: Before/after comparison: ran git-gui.sh directly with same arguments against baseline commit (7c7c7ba4c) and patched commit (3fbef193c) worktrees. Used xvfb-run for virtual display. Invalid arguments that previously opened GUI (exit 124 timeout) now exit 1 with error message.
environment: Linux x86_64, Xvfb virtual display, Tcl/Tk via wish, git 2.49+
